svg.text: tab 10 thick, 60 wide, 20 hole 30 below its top edge

svg.text: 30 hole for the closing line 40 off centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four lugs 40 x 42 x 8 under the beam ends, 13 holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tag rods: four 30 x 6 flat bars, 440 between 13 holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Yoke: two 50 x 6 bars 330 long, 26 hole 30 from the bottom,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: joined by a 50 x 10 crossbar with a 14 hole closing eye

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
